messages.subject: Word cloud for keywords
parts:
Hi all,

was wondering whether anybody knows of R code to create a word cloud (see packages tm, SnowballC, and wordcloud) *for keywords*.  As far as I can see, the usual procedure for word clouds is just based on frequency lists of single texts/text collections. Keyword analysis by contrast involves highlighting those items that are unusually more frequent in a target corpus than in a reference corpus.

Anybody aware of R code available for this purpose?

All pointers appreciated

Chris

messages.subject: Re: Word cloud for keywords
parts:
There's some code in a post I did on a keyword analysis of State of the Union speeches that might help.  

http://francojc.github.io/keyword-analysis/

Note that I use the Relative Frequency Ratio as the statistic for calculating keyness.
